stem: Two breeding lines reverse rank for yield when tested in two environments. What is the most defensible next step before declaring either line broadly superior?
choices: Choose the line with the highest single-plant yield
Repeat standardized replicated trials across relevant environments and record environmental conditions
Average only the best plant from each environment
Ignore the environmental difference because genotype controls yield
rationale: Rank reversal across environments is consistent with genotype-by-environment interaction. Replication and standardized multi-environment evidence are needed before broad superiority claims.
